ambient.speaker: Server Notice
ambient.body: Bellspire Concord reminds travelers: if a reward is not sourced, it is not real. Report ghost loot to the nearest clerk.

ambient.speaker: Roadwarden Pell
ambient.body: Roadwatch call: Hearthmere remains open, but shrine traffic should move in pairs until Little Dawn confirms the lower bell is quiet.

ambient.speaker: Mira Vale
ambient.body: Bellscar Coast recruitment is still locked for this build. Militia board says: bring shields later, bring patience now.

ambient.speaker: Concord Scribe
ambient.body: Saint Veyra docket: starter contracts, Bulwark training, and Roadwarden reports are being filed under First Road priority.

ambient.speaker: Fieldhand Mara
ambient.body: Saw three pilgrims stop at the east wall and turn around. Not panic, exactly. More like the road whispered something rude.

ambient.speaker: Roadwarden Ila
ambient.body: Little Dawn approach is passable. Watch the low stone walls; ash-gray wolves like the fog more than honest people do.

ambient.speaker: Pilgrim Renn
ambient.body: I marked the shrine signs again. If we go under Little Dawn, I can call the prayer marks while you hold front.

ambient.speaker: Edrin Bellhand
ambient.body: Healer note: clean pulls, clear lane calls, no heroic sprinting into bell architecture. I enjoy living.

ambient.speaker: Tallowwick
ambient.body: Object duty accepted. If a glowing shrine mechanism bites me, I reserve the right to complain in three channels.

ambient.speaker: Ysabet Cord
ambient.body: Recruitment reminder: First Road Watch accepts staged local parties. Name the route, name the witnesses, do not invent payment.

ambient.speaker: Dawnward Table
ambient.body: Dawnward Table recruiting patient tanks and healers for training routes. No rage-pulling, no fake loot screenshots.

ambient.speaker: Candleknots
ambient.body: Small guild forming for shrine work, material runs, and quiet dungeon clears. We explain mechanics before bells explain them harder.

ambient.speaker: Oath-Iron Yard
ambient.body: Bulwark trainees rotate shields at the yard. Repair clerks remind everyone that dents with witness names are easier to file.

ambient.speaker: Seven Lanterns Runner
ambient.body: Market note: starter supplies are moving east. If you are taking the first road, buy practical and brag later.

ambient.speaker: Edrin Bellhand
ambient.body: Ready-check rhythm: tank names the pull, healer confirms sightline, object duty repeats the object. We keep this boring and survive.

ambient.speaker: Pilgrim Renn
ambient.body: If the room has a bell, a tag, or wax running through stone, I am assuming it matters until proven otherwise.

ambient.speaker: Ysabet Cord
ambient.body: Filed reminder: simulated local parties are valid for training reports. The report must say who witnessed what and which reward source was used.

ambient.speaker: Pilgrim Ledger
ambient.body: First Road queue note: new Bulwarks should name their route before the shrine, not after the bell starts making opinions.

ambient.speaker: Candle Runner Iset
ambient.body: Little Dawn candles are short again. If anyone is walking past the wax beds, bring steady hands and do not argue with Olla's knots.

ambient.speaker: Pilgrim Renn
ambient.body: Ready means boring. Boring means alive. I am becoming very fond of boring.

ambient.speaker: Edrin Bellhand
ambient.body: If you call the pull before moving, I heal better. It is not magic. It is basic courtesy wearing a robe.

ambient.speaker: Dawnward Table
ambient.body: First Road Watch accepts reports after clear, wipe, or useful warning. The board values honest failure more than imaginary heroics.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: The road keeps moving even when you do not. Somewhere behind you, a contract clerk stamps a page; somewhere ahead, a bell refuses to answer outward.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: The channel shifts like a room door opening. Voices continue before and after you arrive, which is the first rule of a living world.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: Dungeon pressure settles into the party frame. Frontline, Midline, Backline: the map is no longer just geography, it is behavior.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: The cache opens under source law. Materials, reputation, pity, and staged gear all leave paper trails. The world remembers the difference.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: You stop long enough to hear the server breathe: recruitment posts, road warnings, party jokes, and NPC routines moving around the edges of the scene.

dmBeats.speaker: Bellspire Director
dmBeats.body: Rest does not pause the world. It lowers your shoulders enough that the road's smaller sounds come back: wax settling, mail runners passing, party voices checking gear.

rhythms.cadence: Fieldhands, roadwardens, pilgrims, and shrine traffic trade practical warnings.
channelRules: Keep shop/service claims generic unless sourced
rhythms.nextPrompt: Use `listen`, `zone <message>`, or ask the Director for a scene read before traveling.
rhythms.sourceNote: Hearthmere Fields and Road Shrine of Little Dawn source-governed starter-zone social texture.

rhythms.label: Saint Veyra Docket
rhythms.cadence: Concord clerks, trainees, guild boards, and market districts keep the capital moving.
rhythms.nextPrompt: Use `map`, `guild contracts`, or `dm` to turn the city into a usable social hub.
rhythms.sourceNote: Saint Veyra district and service data from compendium/workbook-backed runtime files.

channelRules: Let companions react like people, not menus

rhythms.sourceNote: Local staged party simulation for the first playable Cryptlet route.
